lead.hed: USNI: Navy taps three new yards for seven LCU-1700s in a $280 million deal
lead.insight: USNI News, Tuesday: three new shipyards were selected to build seven Landing Craft Utility vessels as part of a $280 million award to expand production of the heavy-lift amphibious connector, the Navy announced. Conrad Shipyard of Orange, Texas, and Master Boat Builders are among the yards named. Award announcement, not a completed hull.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy photo by SN Jaimie Bethea · DVIDS 9524270 · Public domain · A landing craft, utility departs the well deck of USS Fort Lauderdale (LPD 28) in the Caribbean Sea, Jan. 27, 2026.

political.hed: Defense News: CBO puts Iran combat costs at $38 billion and interceptor stocks down
political.insight: Defense News, Tuesday: the Congressional Budget Office estimates U.S. combat operations against Iran cost about $38 billion through Aug. 1 and consumed between one-half and two-thirds of the combined Patriot, THAAD, SM-3, and SM-6 interceptor inventory since June 2025. Rebuilding those stocks could take at least five years even if production rises. CBO analysis, not a Pentagon inventory dump.

political.hed: Defense News: Pentagon IG says Iranian strikes hit hundreds of U.S. buildings
political.insight: Defense News, Tuesday: a Defense Department inspector general report says CENTCOM told investigators Iranian strikes damaged or destroyed hundreds of buildings and structures at U.S. bases in Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Oman, and Jordan. Operation Epic Fury had cost $33.4 billion as of June 29, the IG said, not counting infrastructure repair. Watchdog report, not a new battle damage assessment from the field.

political.hed: USNI: Cao, Toti, Breckenridge nominated for top Navy jobs
political.insight: USNI News, Tuesday: the White House formally sent the Senate nominations for the top three civilian leadership roles in the Department of the Navy. Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao was nominated to be permanent Navy secretary, with retired Capt. Bill Toti among the other names. Nominations, not confirmations.

tech.hed: Defense News: Air Force says tanker recapitalization will run for decades
tech.insight: Defense News, Tuesday from the Air, Space & Cyber Conference: Air Mobility Command Deputy Commander Maj. Gen. Gerald Donohue said the last KC-135 pilot has not been born, because legacy Stratotankers and KC-46A Pegasus jets will have to be sustained together while the force recapitalizes. Panel argument, not a new tanker contract.

tech.hed: Defense News: Air Force officials say the F-35 held up in Middle East combat
tech.insight: Defense News, Monday from the same conference: Maj. Gen. Brian Laidlaw and Col. Charles A. Fallon said F-35s sustained intense operations in Operation Epic Fury and Operation Midnight Hammer after an independent watchdog had questioned fully mission-capable rates. Laidlaw said the jet performed when properly resourced. Conference remarks, not a new GAO score.

culture.hed: Law & Liberty: Free-speech maximalism still has a terror problem
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: the essay argues Americans treat too many violent acts as speech, and that material-support laws can still reach attackers who wrap themselves in protest language. Essay, not a Supreme Court ruling.

culture.hed: Heritage: A Pacific policy inventory of Trump Administration island actions
culture.insight: Heritage Foundation, Tuesday: the Pacific Policy Inventory compiles publicly reported Trump Administration actions involving Pacific Island countries from January 2025 through September 2026 — agreements, funding, exercises, deployments, and visits. Inventory, not a new treaty.
